notes.title: Join our Playtest from September 18-22
notes.content: [p]Our very first [b]Steam Playtest[/b] for [i]Valkyrie Rising: Hordes of Ragnarök[/i] is here![/p][p]From [b]September 18–22[/b], you’ll have the chance to jump into short, action-packed runs (around 15 minutes each) and test different builds, abilities, and strategies. Whether you just have time for a quick session or want to chain multiple runs, this is your chance to experience the game early and help us shape its future.[/p][p]What you can expect in the Playtest:[/p][list][*][p]Fast-paced runs with skilltrees of three gods[/p][/*][*][p]A glimpse into the Norse-inspired world of Valkyrie Rising[/p][/*][*][p]An opportunity to share your feedback directly with us[/p][/*][/list][p]Your thoughts are invaluable as we continue development — we can’t wait to hear what you think and see the different playstyles you come up with.[/p][p]Head to the [b]Playtest section[/b] on this Steam page, request access, and join the fight from [b]September 18–22[/b].[/p][p]Thank you for taking part in this first step of the journey![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558431/b367414005c17a89281725b2db28d57c1ed4723c.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Valkyrie Rising goes Gamescom 2025! 🎮⚔️
notes.content:
[p]The gates of Asgard open wider than ever… this time at [b]Gamescom 2025[/b]![/p][p][b]Valkyrie Rising: Hordes of Ragnarök[/b] will be [b]playable at the RAW Talent Showcase[/b], part of the Indie Arena Booth in [b]Hall 10.2 (D042–D044)[/b] from [b]August 20–22[/b].[/p][p]What awaits you at the booth:
⚔️ [b]Hands-on demo[/b] – play a slice of the battle right on the show floor
🎮 [b]Meet the devs[/b] – share your thoughts, ask questions, and chat with us directly[/p][p]We’re beyond excited to showcase [b]Valkyrie Rising: Hordes of Ragnarök[/b] among so many amazing indie games, and we’d love to meet some of you in person.[/p][p]If you’re at [b]Gamescom[/b], come say hi and rise with us against the hordes of Ragnarök!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558431/33433ed99e9d2b5f22be2d3751b10ce4b2bf9f12.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Valkyrie Rising Joins Games Forged in Germany! 🇩🇪
notes.content: [p]Brave yourselves, warriors! The horde isn't just in-game this time... it's a whole [i]horde of incredible German games[/i]![/p][p][/p][p][b]Valkyrie Rising: Hordes of Ragnarök [/b]is proud to be a part of the [b]Games Forged in Germany [/b]Steam event.[/p][p][/p][p]Unleash divine powers, gather ancient runes, and craft powerful synergies as you stand against the chaos of Ragnarök. The fate of Asgard hangs in the balance — are you ready to rise?[/p][p][/p][p]Check out the event and discover even more epic games made in Germany![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/Games-Forged-in-Germany" style="button" buttoncolor="#ca4531"]Games Forged in Germany[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558431/0a6414372e14143bf81363fa03e1e01a3454cc24.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: New Name, New Look – Same Epic Battle!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1][p][/p][p]We’ve been listening to your feedback, and we’re excited to share a big update:[/p][h3]
[b]Thrud – Valkyrie Rising[/b] is now called [b]Valkyrie Rising: Hordes of Ragnarök[/b]![/h3][p][/p][p]Alongside the new name, we’ve also updated the game’s key art to better reflect horde-like gameplay and Norse atmosphere that define the experience. Our goal is to make it immediately clear what the game is all about — defending Asgard from unending hordes in a battle worthy of the gods.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558431/86f68daf07ae96af4863149b7128cab14f1bcb23.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]But Don't Worry[b] - Thrud is still here[/b]![/h3][p][/p][p]You’ll continue your journey as the fierce Valkyrie Thrud, standing strong against the hordes of Ragnarök.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you love the new direction as much as we do. Let us know what you think — your feedback continues to shape this world we're building together.[/p][p][/p][p][b]See you in Asgard, warriors![/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
